greeting: Namaste! I can help you compare [universities](/universities), [colleges](/colleges), [courses](/courses), fees, and consultation booking.
Namaste — ask me about study options, admissions help, or how to book a consultation on the [booking page](/booking).
नमस्ते! Study in Nepal मा स्वागत छ — कसरी मद्दत गर्न सक्छु?
hello: Hi! I can help with study options, admissions, and consultation booking.
thank_you: Happy to help — ask me anything about studying in Nepal.
goodbye: Goodbye! Best of luck with your study plans.
services: We help with university selection, course planning, admissions support, consultation booking, and follow-up. You can jump to [universities](/universities), [colleges](/colleges), or the [booking page](/booking).
Our team helps with applications, document checks, fee estimates, and scholarship guidance.
universities: You can browse all universities here: [Universities](/universities). Examples: Tribhuvan University, Kathmandu University, Pokhara University, and Purbanchal University. Ask me about any specific university for fees and programs.
I can list top universities or show universities by discipline — tell me which subject you want.
Try: 'Tell me about Kathmandu University' or 'Show universities for medicine'
schools: You can explore schools at [Schools](/school). I can help you compare top schools like Euro School Nepal.
Try: 'Show top schools in Kathmandu' or 'Tell me about Euro School Nepal'.
tests: Many programs are English-medium; test requirements (IELTS/TOEFL) depend on the university and course. I can check specific programs if you name the university.
If you need test prep or acceptable scores for an institution, ask me the university and program name.
fees: Fees depend on the institution and course, but Nepal is generally more affordable than many study destinations. Budget for tuition, living costs, transport, and documents.
The site describes Nepal as a cost-effective study destination. Exact fees vary, so the booking or contact page is the best place to confirm your case.
contact: Phone: +977 9860540054. Email: inquire@studyinnepal.info. Address: Miteripul, Mandikatar, Kathmandu, Nepal. For fast follow-up, use WhatsApp or the [contact page](/contact).
Use the [contact page](/contact) for detailed admission support, or WhatsApp for a faster follow-up during Nepal business hours.
consultation: You can book a consultation on the [booking page](/booking). Enter your preferred time and we'll confirm by WhatsApp or email.
If you want a free consultation, say 'Book consultation' and I'll start the process.
colleges: Colleges and affiliated campuses are listed on university pages; tell me which university and I can show affiliated colleges.
Try: 'Show colleges for Tribhuvan University' or 'List colleges near Kathmandu'
about: Study in Nepal helps students discover schools, +2 colleges, and universities in Nepal, compare programs, understand fees, and get admission support from inquiry to enrollment.
We promote Nepali education pathways globally and provide practical guidance for admissions, documentation, and consultation booking.
facilities: Typical campus facilities include libraries, labs, hostels, sports grounds, cafeterias, and medical centers. Ask about facilities for a specific university or browse [universities](/universities) and [colleges](/colleges).
Tell me a university and I will list its campus facilities and student services.
scholarships: Scholarships vary by university and program. Some merit-based and need-based scholarships are available — ask about a specific university or program.
We can help find external scholarship options and guide you through application steps.
